## Activity

During April 2023, West Gate Eye Clinic recorded 393 captures. This represents the activity completed by the clinic during the reporting month. Capture volumes should continue to be monitored through routine site operations reporting so that any changes in workload can be identified and addressed promptly.

## Image quality

Of the 393 captures, 18 were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 4.6. Recurring camera issues should be logged with the service desk to support timely investigation and help maintain image quality. The clinic should continue to follow local procedures for equipment checks and reporting where image quality concerns are identified.

## Grading

Grading identified 96 referable results. The median lag between capture and grading was 2. This measure should be reviewed alongside activity and image-quality results to support timely processing and oversight of the service. Overall, the report provides a summary of capture activity, ungradable images and referable grading outcomes for West Gate Eye Clinic during April 2023.
